genericProblem: A generated contract pipeline can silently erase a valid component field or recreate an obsolete field when one global rule is applied without component-specific exceptions and when accepted v2s semantics are assumed to equal heritage schema shape.
rootCauseClass: single-source reconciliation failure: global materializer policy plus missing explicit v2s override and incomplete consumer-payload proof
finiteDenominator: all catalog componentOverrides forbiddenProperties and preserveProperties
all WorkspaceSessionEntry, WorkspaceOperationsInvitationActionRequest, OrganizationStoreCreateRequest and StoreContractCreateRequest surfaces
all same-name requiredDataNodeType property occurrences in materialized component schemas and generated platform/operations consumers
all generated OpenAPI outputs and edge-codegen Java/TypeScript consumers
all diagnostic workload request bodies for create and invitation action commands
searchQueries: forbiddenProperties preserveProperties expectedContextVersion projectId scopeContext selectedDataNode WorkspaceScopeNode
requiredDataNodeType all contract/generated schema occurrences HEAD_COMPANY
operations diagnostic workload invitation reissue cancel create body
counterexamples: Workspace user assignment revoke intentionally remains without expectedContextVersion; the exception is limited to WorkspaceOperationsInvitationActionRequest.
Platform/operations read queries may legitimately carry projectId only where the catalog explicitly declares it; create commands do not.
Heritage selectedDataNode is not accepted v2s truth; runtime/backend/frontend already consume scopeContext.
WorkspaceRolePage.pageAccessCatalog previously lacked HEAD_COMPANY while owner pageCatalog emitted it; the corrected enum addition now covers the same-name site.

findings.cause: global forbidden-property pass removed the invitation action context field
findings.fix: component-aware preserveProperties and explicit workload assertions

findings.cause: contract source drifted from accepted U27 scopeContext/project-derivation semantics
findings.fix: catalog/materializer/placement reconciliation and regenerated wire consumers

findings.cause: single-reference allOf was resolved for schema merging but not for Java property type selection
findings.fix: materialize accepted scope references as direct refs with nullable annotation and keep generated type selection deterministic

findings.cause: nested enum additions were applied before missing references were inlined
findings.fix: apply the narrow enum addition after inlining and assert both candidate and selected navigation enums

findings.cause: same-name requiredDataNodeType scan stopped after session navigation and omitted WorkspaceRolePage.pageAccessCatalog
findings.fix: add WorkspaceRolePage.enumAdditions plus a dedicated role-page positive/red materializer control and expand denominator to every same-name occurrence

findings.cause: invitation action review criterion collapsed a four-field payload to expectedContextVersion only
findings.fix: restate the criterion as owner consumption of optional scopeRef plus required expectedContextVersion, expectedVersion and idempotencyKey
